about.registryInfo: ComTech FZCO, a company incorporated in the United Arab Emirates and registered in the Dubai Airport Free Zone Authority (DAFZA), 100% owned by Trade Fintech Ltd, a private company incorporated under the Companies Law, DIFC Law No. 5 of 2018 on 4 October 2021 with registered number 5102. ComTech FZCO issues ComTech Gold (CGO) tokens representing ownership of 1 gram of 999.9 fine gold per token.
